CHANGES made since since the VCL 3.02 release:

- Added TNetDialogs components (netdlgs.pas)
- Added TWin95Pie component (win95pie.pas)
- Added TRegistry object (registry.pas)

NOTE: The StringAsPChar() function in STRINGS.PAS has been renamed
to StrPChar(). If you use this function in any of your projects,
you should rename any instance of StringAsPChar to StrPChar.
